sources.title: Getting Started with Q-Learning on FrozenLake-v1 - fxis.ai
sources.snippet: Let's dive into the realm of AI and uncover how to get your Q-Learning agent moving across the treacherous ice blocks! What is FrozenLake-v1? FrozenLake-v1 is a classic reinforcement learning environment where an agent must navigate across a frozen lake while avoiding holes and gracefully stepping on safe tiles.
